```{r setup}
library(yulab.utils)
library(bench)
library(ggplot2)
```

## 设计思路

`chunked_array` 的核心优势在于**拼接（concatenation）不做数据拷贝**——它只是把新的 chunk 追加到列表中，
代价是后续的**随机访问**需要定位 chunk。本文档全面对比这两种策略在不同操作场景下的性能表现。

## 1. 拼接性能（核心优势场景）

### 1.1 两两拼接

```{r bench-concat-pair}
sizes <- c(1e3, 1e4, 1e5, 1e6)

bench_concat <- bench::press(
  n = sizes,
  {
    a <- seq_len(n)
    b <- seq_len(n)
    ca <- as_chunked_array(a)
    cb <- as_chunked_array(b)
    bench::mark(
      vector    = c(a, b),
      chunked   = c2(ca, cb),
      check     = FALSE,
      min_iterations = 50
    )
  }
)

bench_concat
```

```{r plot-concat-pair}
autoplot(bench_concat) +
  labs(title = "两两拼接: c() vs c2()",
       subtitle = "chunked_array 避免数据拷贝，向量越大优势越明显") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

### 1.2 迭代拼接（循环追加）

这是 `chunked_array` 的**最佳使用场景**：在循环中不断追加数据。
传统 vector 每次 `c()` 都会重新分配内存，复杂度为 O(n²)。

```{r bench-concat-iter}
n_iters <- c(100, 500, 1000, 2000)
chunk_size <- 100

bench_iter <- bench::press(
  n = n_iters,
  {
    chunks <- lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) seq_len(chunk_size))
    bench::mark(
      vector = {
        v <- integer(0)
        for (ch in chunks) v <- c(v, ch)
        v
      },
      chunked = {
        ca <- as_chunked_array(integer(0))
        for (ch in chunks) ca <- c2(ca, ch)
        ca
      },
      check = FALSE,
      min_iterations = 5
    )
  }
)

bench_iter
```

```{r plot-concat-iter}
autoplot(bench_iter) +
  labs(title = "迭代拼接: 循环 c() vs 循环 c2()",
       subtitle = "vector 的 O(n²) 拷贝 vs chunked_array 的 O(1) 追加") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

## 2. 索引访问性能

### 2.1 单元素随机访问

```{r bench-index-single}
N <- 1e6
vec <- seq_len(N)
ca  <- Reduce(c2, lapply(split(vec, ceiling(seq_along(vec) / 1000)), as_chunked_array))
# ca 有 1000 个 chunk，每个 1000 元素

set.seed(42)
random_idx <- sample(N, 1000)

bench_single <- bench::mark(
  vector  = { for (i in random_idx) vec[i] },
  chunked = { for (i in random_idx) ca[i] },
  check   = FALSE,
  min_iterations = 10
)

bench_single
```

### 2.2 批量切片访问

```{r bench-index-batch}
slice_sizes <- c(10, 100, 1000, 10000)

bench_slice <- bench::press(
  k = slice_sizes,
  {
    idx <- sample(N, k)
    bench::mark(
      vector  = vec[idx],
      chunked = ca[idx],
      check   = FALSE,
      min_iterations = 50
    )
  }
)

bench_slice
```

```{r plot-index-batch}
autoplot(bench_slice) +
  labs(title = "批量索引: vector[i] vs chunked_array[i]",
       subtitle = "chunked_array 需要 chunk 定位开销") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

## 3. 转换与还原

```{r bench-as-vector}
sizes_conv <- c(1e4, 1e5, 1e6)

bench_conv <- bench::press(
  n = sizes_conv,
  {
    v <- seq_len(n)
    ca <- Reduce(c2, lapply(split(v, ceiling(seq_along(v) / 1000)), as_chunked_array))
    bench::mark(
      as.vector = as.vector(ca),
      check     = FALSE,
      min_iterations = 20
    )
  }
)

bench_conv
```

## 4. length() 计算

```{r bench-length}
bench_len <- bench::mark(
  vector  = length(vec),
  chunked = length(ca),
  check   = FALSE,
  min_iterations = 1000
)

bench_len
```

## 5. 内存占用对比

```{r bench-memory}
n_chunks <- c(10, 100, 1000)
chunk_sz <- 1000

mem_results <- lapply(n_chunks, function(nc) {
  v <- seq_len(nc * chunk_sz)
  ca <- Reduce(c2, lapply(split(v, ceiling(seq_along(v) / chunk_sz)), as_chunked_array))
  data.frame(
    n_chunks    = nc,
    total_elems = nc * chunk_sz,
    vec_bytes   = as.numeric(object.size(v)),
    ca_bytes    = as.numeric(object.size(ca)),
    overhead    = sprintf("%.1f%%", (as.numeric(object.size(ca)) / as.numeric(object.size(v)) - 1) * 100)
  )
})

mem_df <- do.call(rbind, mem_results)
knitr::kable(mem_df, col.names = c("Chunks", "Total Elements", "Vector (bytes)", 
                                     "Chunked Array (bytes)", "Overhead"),
             caption = "内存占用对比")
```

## 6. 总结

```{r summary-table}
#| echo: false
summary_df <- data.frame(
  操作 = c("两两拼接", "迭代拼接 (循环追加)", "单元素随机访问", 
           "批量切片访问", "length()", "内存占用"),
  chunked_array = c("✅ 快 (O(1), 无拷贝)", 
                     "✅✅ 极快 (O(1) vs O(n²))",
                     "⚠️ 略慢 (chunk 定位开销)", 
                     "⚠️ 略慢 (chunk 定位开销)",
                     "⚠️ 略慢 (链式计算)", 
                     "⚠️ 略高 (list 结构开销)"),
  适用建议 = c("大向量拼接", 
              "⭐ 最佳场景：循环累积数据",
              "频繁随机访问请转 as.vector()", 
              "大批量访问请转 as.vector()",
              "可忽略", 
              "chunk 越多开销越大")
)

knitr::kable(summary_df, align = "lll",
             caption = "chunked_array vs vector 性能特征总结")
```

> **使用建议**：`chunked_array` 最适合**写多读少**的场景——在循环中不断追加数据，
> 最后一次性 `as.vector()` 转换。如果需要频繁随机访问，建议尽早转换为普通 vector。
